'''Marco Zarik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Marco Zarik appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunting Week event. He can appear on any of the following worlds: [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Voss]]. The player has the option to ask him for information nicely, rudely or neutrally. In any case, he provides the location of a local crime lord's henchman. As such, his role in the game is almost entirely random or player-driven and a canonical path currently cannot be determined.
